valuation_clock.flow_timing: midpoint of each quarter's remaining interval
valuation_clock.revenue_price: average simulated daily gold price over the remaining interval
valuation_clock.discounting: piecewise-constant annual WACC from the valuation date; year 1 = wacc_0
valuation_clock.terminal: Gordon value at 2030-12-31 on the last four quarters

simulation.common_random_numbers_note: All four engines share one base seed; WACC shocks are generated once and reused.

gold_price_layer.path_engine: src/barrick_unified/gold_paths.py (full truncation, exact Hawkes intensity integral, daily grid)

common_scenario_start.source_definition: XAUUSD midpoint at 2026-09-02T20:00:00Z, synchronous with the GLD close and the valuation time

common_scenario_drift.method: Team 8 U.S. Treasury NSS curve converted to integral-preserving daily forward rates
common_scenario_drift.measure: physical scenario under the declared assumption of no gold risk premium (forward-unbiased expectation); the option-implied volatility shape is a conditional, non-validated bridge. Risk-free discounting of the explicit flows is reported for comparison.

conditional_bridge.label: conditional transfer of GLD/Q distributional shape to gold USD/oz
conditional_bridge.interpretation: Controlled research sensitivity of distributional shape only; not fair value, target price or investment recommendation.

reported_quantities.reason: The equity bridge (debt, cash, minorities, other claims) is still a zero placeholder; per-share values and market comparisons have no interpretation.

assumptions_added.value: 2026Q3 contributes 28/92 of its forecast production and margin
assumptions_added.caveat: uniform intra-quarter operating rate; no operating model of the stub
